consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Real git output of `git worktree list --porcelain` that no CI runner can produce: git 2.34.1 refusing -z (exit 129) and a listing that fails on a malformed .git/config (exit 128, git 2.34.1 and 2.43.0 alike), plus git 2.34.1's newline listing of a worktree path holding a newline. Recorded 2026-09-30 by the M6-P3 fix round 4 recording script (the capture's own provenance says how). Required by rule (f) because every member mutates src/pool.ts, which spawns git and parses what it prints. The named test replays the recorded stderr and exit through a git stub on PATH that answers only the listing and delegates every other call to the real git.
